-- Buscar pagamento de R$247 do Luciano (pode estar em bpo_charges ou em outro lugar)
SELECT id, type, value, due_date, status, description, client_name, classified_by, source, created_at
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE client_email = 'gabnercorporation@gmail.com'
  AND (value BETWEEN 240 AND 260 OR value BETWEEN 24000 AND 26000)
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
